messages.subject: LogiConnect Europe 2026 — partnership tiers closing Friday
messages.body:
Hi Chloe,

Following up on our call last week! The LogiConnect Europe partner tiers close this Friday, 13 March, and I wanted to make sure you had the full picture:

- Silver sponsorship: €6,000 — includes the booth, your logo on stage screens and the event app, one 10-minute lightning talk slot, and the attendee contact list post-event (last year: 2,300 opted-in contacts)
- Booth only: €2,500 — booth space plus app listing, no talk, no contact list

Given your growth in the courier vertical, Silver has been our best-converting tier for logistics SaaS vendors. Happy to hold either option for you until Friday.

Best,
Paula Reyes
Partnerships, LogiConnect Europe

messages.subject: RE: LogiConnect Europe 2026 — partnership tiers closing Friday
messages.body:
Hi all!

Paula's offer is attached below. Super excited about this one — LogiConnect is THE event for our exact buyer (courier ops managers), and last year's attendee list is basically our ICP. My take:

- Silver at €6,000 gets us the lightning talk + the 2,300-contact list, which alone is worth more than the fee if we convert even 1%
- Booth-only saves €3,500 but we'd be one of 60 logos nobody remembers

I've drafted a 10-slide talk outline (deck here: share.parcelwise.example/chloe/logiconnect-silver-deck) and it practically writes itself — "route planning for the last mile, without the last-minute panic" 🎯

Chloe, super excited!! (yes I know I already said that)

messages.subject: RE: LogiConnect Europe 2026 — partnership tiers closing Friday
messages.body:
Dear Marta, dear Chloe,

A word of caution before we commit. I have no objection to the event itself, but €6,000 is at the top of what I would consider for a single marketing activity this quarter, and I would gently note that the lightning talk and contact list are unproven channels for us. If we attend, the booth-only option at €2,500 achieves the presence; the incremental €3,500 buys us a contact list of questionable opt-in quality — Paula's figure includes every past attendee who ticked a box, not leads.

That said, if Marta sees the lead-generation value, I will not stand in the way; I merely ask that we measure the outcome.

Kind regards,
Helen
Helen Oyelaran | Chief Financial Officer | Parcelwise B.V.
